rules.statement: The Court has the power to reopen a transaction and take an account between parties where a mortgage bond was entered into to secure a loan in respect of which promissory notes, which were 'fictitious' within the meaning of section 14 of the Money Lending Ordinance, were given.
rules.supporting_quote: Held, further , that the Court has power under section 2 of the Money Lending Ordinance to reopen the transaction and to take an account between the parties.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Money Lending Ordinance, No. 2 of 1918. ss. 2. 10. and 14.

meta.parties: Sockalingam Chettiar v. Ramanayake Et Al
